# Intake Brief: Serial Seller challenge (MS-0MUI7ZJK8003HY9J)

**Headline:** Add a run-local **Serial Seller** challenge that completes when the player sells 3 or more street businesses in a single game, with live progress in the challenge HUD and a persistent Steam achievement consistent with the existing 12 challenges.

## Problem statement

Main Street's challenge pool currently has no goal that rewards _selling_ businesses, so the sell mechanic (Manage Card → Sell) is rarely a deliberate strategic path. This item adds a new run-local challenge, **Serial Seller**, that completes when the player sells 3 or more businesses in a single game, and shows live progress toward the goal in the challenge HUD.

## Users

- **Main Street players** choosing a strategy each run.
- **Main Street players** who need to gauge progress at a glance.
- **The designer/producer**, who wants the new challenge consistent with the existing challenge/achievement system.

Example user stories:

- As a Main Street player, I want a challenge that rewards selling businesses, so that a sell-and-reinvest strategy is a viable route to bonus points.
- As a player, I want to see my progress toward the challenge (e.g. "2/3 sold"), so I know how close I am to completing it.
- As the producer, I want the new challenge mapped to a persistent Steam achievement like the other 12 challenges, so the achievement set stays complete and consistent.

## Acceptance Criteria

- New challenge template and category: `ch-serial-seller` (title **Serial Seller**, description "Sell 3 or more businesses in a single game.") is added to `CHALLENGE_TEMPLATES` with `category: 'economic'` and `rewardPoints === CHALLENGE_BONUS_POINTS`; a new `economic` member is added to the `ChallengeCategory` union; its evaluator returns `true` iff the cumulative count of sold street businesses in the run is `>= 3`, and `false` on an empty grid.
- System integration and progress UI: the template participates in deterministic `selectChallenges` selection; completing it fires exactly once through `evaluateChallengesAfterAction` (bonus points awarded, activity-log entry written, persistent-achievement bridge invoked); the challenge HUD tracker renders live progress (e.g. `2/3`) for progress-capable challenges while challenges without progress metadata render unchanged.
- Undo/redo consistency: undoing a street sale reverts both the progress count and any challenge completion it caused; redo re-applies them exactly once (no double completion, no stale progress).
- Achievement mapping and cross-repo dependency: `ch-serial-seller` maps to achievement id `serial-seller` in `CHALLENGE_TO_ACHIEVEMENT_ID`; the blocking dependency work item (`MS-0MUOLL8W2004A3D7`, discovered-from this item) supplies the `core` submodule `electron/achievement-manifest.json` entry and the Steamworks backend API name (`TCE_MAIN_STREET_SERIAL_SELLER`); the achievement completeness/drift tests pass once the dependency has landed.
- Testing and validation: unit tests cover the evaluator (empty grid, 1/2/3 sales), selection inclusion, progress metadata, HUD progress rendering, and undo/redo.
- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Only street/tableau sales via the **Manage Card → Sell** dialog count (the `sellBusiness` path, tracked by `state.soldSlots`). Hand sales (`sellFromHand`) and the legacy `sellFromTableau` path are out of scope.
- **No new game-state field.** Reuse `state.soldSlots` (it is cumulative for the interactive path, because sold cards stay on the grid and cannot be closed) so save/load and command snapshots keep working unchanged.
- Existing tests assert **12** templates and category coverage for the 5 existing categories; these must be updated to 13 and (optionally) to assert `economic`. The category-coverage assertion for the original 5 categories must still hold.
- The achievement mapping is enforced by `tests/main-street/main-street-achievements.test.ts` against the launcher manifest, which lives in the **`core` git submodule (a separate repository)** — the manifest entry and Steamworks API name are handled by a separate **blocking dependency** work item `MS-0MUOLL8W2004A3D7` (producer/external action), not run-local.
- The per-run selection count (`config.challengesPerRun`, default 3) and the end-of-game scoring formula are unchanged — only the template pool grows.
- The progress indicator must fit the existing challenge panel geometry (compact single-line rows); avoid layout regressions.
- All written output in UK English.

## Existing state

- `src/MainStreetChallenges.ts` defines the `ChallengeCategory` union (`synergy`, `placement`, `resource`, `upgrade`, `cross-cutting`), 12 `CHALLENGE_TEMPLATES`, `DEFAULT_CHALLENGES_PER_RUN = 3`, and `selectChallenges`/`evaluateChallenges` wrappers over the generic `@core-engine` challenge API. Evaluators are pure functions of `MainStreetState`. Selection is seeded from `config.challengesPerRun` in `src/MainStreetStateSetup.ts`.
- Challenge evaluation runs after every action (`evaluateChallengesAfterAction`) and at end of turn; completions are non-revocable during a run but are captured/restored by command snapshots (`captureSnapshot`/`restoreSnapshot` in `src/MainStreetCommands.ts`, which include `soldSlots`, `challengesCompleted`, and per-challenge completion flags).
- `state.soldSlots: boolean[]` marks sold street cards; sold cards remain on the grid as inert synergy anchors and cannot be closed, so the true-count is monotonic for the interactive path and is captured in undo snapshots.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts` (`refreshChallengeTracker`) renders the challenge panel as compact rows: indicator + title + description, with a `Challenges (n/N)` header. There is currently no per-challenge progress display.
- `src/MainStreetAchievements.ts` maps every challenge template 1:1 to a persistent Steam achievement; `tests/main-street/main-street-achievements.test.ts` guards completeness and drift against `core/electron/achievement-manifest.json`.

## Desired change

- Add an `economic` challenge category and the `ch-serial-seller` template with an evaluator counting sold street businesses and an optional progress provider.
- Add an optional `progress?: (state: MainStreetState) => { current: number; target: number }` field to the `Challenge` interface and render it in the challenge HUD tracker (e.g. `2/3`), leaving progress-less challenges visually unchanged.
- Add the `serial-seller` achievement mapping and create the blocking dependency work item for the `core` manifest entry + Steamworks API name.
- Update the affected tests (template count, evaluator/selection/progress/undo, achievement mapping) and documentation.

Design note: keeping progress as an **optional Main Street-specific** field on `Challenge` (rather than extending the generic `ChallengeDefinition<TState>` in `@core-engine`) keeps the change surgical and avoids touching the core engine. If a second progress-capable challenge is added later, promoting the field to the generic interface can be revisited.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `src/MainStreetChallenges.ts` — add `economic` to `ChallengeCategory`, add optional `progress` to `Challenge`, add the `ch-serial-seller` template (evaluator + progress).
- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts` — render progress in `refreshChallengeTracker`.
- `src/MainStreetAchievements.ts` — add `'ch-serial-seller': 'serial-seller'` to `CHALLENGE_TO_ACHIEVEMENT_ID`.
- `tests/main-street/challenges.test.ts` — update template count (12 → 13); add evaluator, selection, and progress-metadata tests.
- `tests/main-street/main-street-achievements.test.ts` — mapping completeness/drift now includes `serial-seller` (green once the child manifest entry lands).
- `tests/main-street/` challenge-HUD/scene test — add progress-rendering coverage (extend an existing scene/HUD test or add a focused one).
- `core/electron/achievement-manifest.json` — **blocking dependency** `MS-0MUOLL8W2004A3D7` (core submodule): add the `serial-seller` entry with `TCE_MAIN_STREET_SERIAL_SELLER`.
- `docs/main-street/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` and/or `docs/main-street/prd-milestone-2.md` — document the new challenge/category if the challenge catalogue is described there.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetConstants.ts` — only if the progress indicator requires a layout constant tweak (avoid if possible).

## Risks and assumptions

- **Cross-repo achievement dependency (blocking, build impact).** The manifest lives in the `core` submodule and the drift guard (`tests/main-street/main-street-achievements.test.ts`) fails the build until the dependency (`MS-0MUOLL8W2004A3D7`) lands and the submodule pointer is bumped. Sequence the dependency first; this item must not reach `in_review` ahead of it.
- **Test friction from template count.** Several tests derive from `CHALLENGE_TEMPLATES.length`; only `challenges.test.ts` hardcodes 12. Keep the category-coverage list at the original 5 so `economic` is not required to have ≥2 templates (scope creep risk — do not add a second economic challenge here; capture as a separate linked work item).
- **Undo semantics.** Because completion is flagged on the `ActiveChallenge` and also recorded in `challengesCompleted`, redo must not double-add. Existing per-action reset (`completedChallengeIds.length = 0`) already guards this; add regression coverage.
- **Progress layout.** The challenge rows are compact; a progress suffix must not overlap the description column. Verify at the shipping HUD width.
- **Assumption:** `soldSlots` true-count is the intended "businesses sold" metric (confirmed by producer, Q6 = a). If a future non-street sell path should count, a state counter will be needed — out of scope.
- **Assumption:** final player-facing text is title **Serial Seller** and description "Sell 3 or more businesses in a single game." (producer-confirmed Q7 update); the `economic` category keeps the original 5-category coverage assertions intact.
- **Scope-creep risk:** adding more economic challenges, changing reward points, adding new achievement art, or counting hand/legacy sells are out of scope; capture as linked work items.

## Related work

- `MS-0MUNO0M2I004TK04` (`Wire Main Street challenges to Steam achievements`, stage `plan_complete`) / `CG-0MUNC7FK5001T5CP` — established the 1:1 challenge→achievement mapping and drift guard this item extends.
- `CG-0MU37CKRR008252I` — per-action challenge evaluation (the path that completes this challenge after a sell).
- `CG-0MTCP7F9S009HARC` / `CG-0MT5XT7K3005IBBV` — Sell vs Close mechanics (sold markers, undo snapshot/restore).
- `MS-0MUMAZTAY00515MC` (`Main Street: verify capacity-stable HandView slots (bump core submodule …)`, completed/`in_review`) — precedent for bumping the `core` submodule pointer from a Main Street change, as the blocking dependency here will need to do.
- Automated related-work report — see the `
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **MS-0MUBVL4H80061B1E** – Assign dedicated card art to every Main Street card (1024×1024 source; eliminate generic Fallback art) (open)
- **MS-0MUAYBAHW007RMSL** – Add a charity shop (completed)
- **MS-0MUO7FS95000OLN9** – When adding a card to the market slot using the developer cheat menu can't take card (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `core/docs/DEVELOPER.md` — matched: 0mu37ckrr008252i, acceptance, accepted, achievement, achievements (+351 more)
- `core/AGENTS.md` — matched: acceptance, accepted, achievement, achievements, action (+283 more)
- `docs/main-street/prd-milestone-2.md` — matched: 0mu37ckrr008252i, acceptance, achievement, achievements, action (+260 more)

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- **Q1: Scope of "sell 3 businesses" — cumulative across the run or within a single turn?**
  - Answer (producer): **(a) total businesses sold across the entire game run (cumulative).** Source: interactive reply, comment `MS-C0MUOE84S1001BB5M`.
- **Q2: Which challenge category?**
  - Answer (producer): **(c) create a new `economic` category** for buy/sell/space-management challenges. Source: interactive reply.
- **Q3: Reward points?**
  - Answer (producer): **(a) standard `CHALLENGE_BONUS_POINTS`** (same as the existing 12). Source: interactive reply.
- **Q4: UI feedback — progress or title/description only?**
  - Answer (producer): **progress** (e.g. "2/3 businesses sold"). Source: interactive reply.
- **Q5: Persistent Steam achievement?**
  - Answer (producer): **(a)** map to a persistent Steam achievement, with the `core`-submodule manifest + Steamworks backend config split into a separate **blocking child** work item. Source: interactive reply, comment `MS-C0MUOHDERC008QLXL`. Research: `src/MainStreetAchievements.ts` maps all 12 templates 1:1; `tests/main-street/main-street-achievements.test.ts` guards completeness and drift against `core/electron/achievement-manifest.json`, which is tracked in the `core` submodule (separate repo).
- **Q6: Which sale actions count?**
  - Answer (producer): **(a) only street/tableau sales via Manage Card → Sell**, tracked by the existing `soldSlots` array; no new state counter. Source: interactive reply. Research: `sellBusiness` (`src/MainStreetMarketSell.ts`) leaves sold cards on the grid and sets `soldSlots`; sold cards cannot be closed, so the count is monotonic and undo-aware.
- **Q7: Player-facing title?**
  - Prior answer: (b) "Wheel and Deal". **Updated by the producer to the agent recommendation (a) "Serial Seller"** — final accepted title: **Serial Seller**. Source: interactive replies (initial comment `MS-C0MUOE84S1001BB5M` / update in-session).
- **Open items:** none — all interview questions answered.

  **Answer (producer):** Serial Seller
